about: The Nation / La Nation is a bilingual municipality in the United Counties of Prescott and Russell, Ontario, east of Ottawa, covering villages such as Limoges, St. Isidore, and Fournier—not a single city. French- and English-speaking farm communities share the landscape between Ottawa and the Quebec border. About 13,000 people live in The Nation.
